summary.en: Chainlink's settlement TWAP follows Binance spot with a lag. When spot has already moved since the market opened and the book has not priced it, take that side. Reads each coin's own Binance spot feed (declare one per coin; no HYPE).
summary.zh: Chainlink 结算 TWAP 跟随币安现货但有滞后。现货自开盘以来已经明显移动、盘口还没跟上时，买入这一边。每个币读自己的币安现货流（每个币都要声明；HYPE 没有）。
